default.title: Why TMS implementations overrun
default.content: In a survey of 120 transport management system rollouts, 64% finished later than planned. Master data problems were the most common cause, cited by 41% of teams.

default.title: Carrier onboarding costs
default.content: Teams that standardised carrier data before go-live reported 30% fewer post-launch defects than teams that cleaned data during the project.

default.title: The data-first rollout
default.content: Practitioners argue that rate and location data quality decides whether a TMS delivers its savings; configuration choices matter less.

default.title: A dissenting view on TMS delays
default.content: Some delays come from scope growth, not data: one study found scope changes behind 35% of overruns.
